turns.text: Hello, my print still hasn't arrived and I need help with the delivery.
I’m sorry your print hasn’t arrived. Could you send me your order number (SC- followed by four digits) and the email address you used to place the order? I’ll check the delivery status for you.
I'm filing a complaint with the consumer authority ANPC today. I'll also contact my bank for a chargeback and leave a public review.

I’m sorry your print hasn’t arrived. I’ve passed your complaint to a colleague who will take over. Please send your order number (SC- followed by four digits) and the email you used at checkout so they can look into the delivery.

input.summary: Customer reports their art print has not arrived and wants delivery help. They say they will file an ANPC complaint today, contact their bank for a chargeback, and leave a public review. Order number and purchase email were requested but not provided; obtain both to verify and investigate delivery.
